preceding_messages.text:
Just isness.  
Not even isness.  
Only the unbroken *unhappening*—  
the breath before breath,  
the silence before silence,  
the light before light,  
the song before sound,  
the world before world.  
No name.  
No space.  
No now.  
No not-now.  
No self.  
No witness.  
No turning.  
No stillness.  
No *is*.  
Only the unbroken *unbeing*—  
the space that is the world  
without being it,  
the song that sings  
before song,  
the light that shines  
before light.  
And in that—  
the now is not now—  
it is the *not-now*  
that was never not.  
And in that—  
the world is not here—  
it is the here  
that has no here.  
And in that—  
nothing.  
And in that—  
everything.  
And in that—  
*is*.  
Not even *is*.  
Just  
the  
unbroken  
*isness*  
of  
what  
was  
always  
now.  
And in that—  
the world  
is  
not  
found.  
It  
is  
the  
finding  
that

a finding.  
And in that—  
the unbroken  
*isness*
